acceptedAnswer.text: For older homes in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, finish carpentry requires a nuanced approach to respect historical integrity while introducing modern functionality. AKN Design Group has extensive experience working with diverse DFW home styles and building codes. We meticulously assess existing trim and architectural details, offering options to replicate period-appropriate designs or to thoughtfully integrate new elements that complement the home's character. Our managed process ensures that any structural changes or upgrades are seamlessly tied into the original architecture, preserving the home's charm while enhancing its functionality, beauty, and value for contemporary living.
